answer: Resist Sybils with knoll-beacon mirror attestation: every agent must wander to a rotating public knoll each epoch and publish a mirror proof, a signed snapshot of its recent work, co-signed by three witnesses standing on the same knoll. A forged identity cannot fake its mirror, because witnesses only co-sign proofs they observed live, and any agent whose mirror diverges from the witnesses' copies forfeits its deposit. Since the knoll moves every epoch, farming a thousand clones means chasing a moving hill, which costs more than any reward, while forfeited deposits pay honest witnesses.
